A LITTLE ABOUT ME

Accurate records.
Clear financial insight.

An accounting professional committed to accurate financial records, disciplined compliance processes and continuous professional development.

MY APPROACH
Professional integrity is reflected in the accuracy of every record and the reliability of every result.ACCOUNTING · COMPLIANCE · IMPROVEMENT

I hold a Bachelor of Commerce degree in Computer Applications and have practical experience in accounting operations within a private limited company. My work includes bookkeeping, journal entries, ledger scrutiny, account reconciliations, GST and TDS compliance support, and financial documentation.

Using Zoho Books and MS Excel, I maintain accounting records, review ledger balances, investigate discrepancies and prepare supporting schedules for statutory and management requirements. I have also worked on GST refund documentation and income-tax return preparation. Complementary learning in corporate finance, data analytics and project management strengthens my broader business perspective.

I offer careful, transparent finance support to businesses through Fincom Consultancy Services.
